Making tp_btf able to use bpf_dynptr_from_skb()

column2: especially for non-linear paged skb data. This is achieved by

column1: adding KF_TRUSTED_ARGS flag to bpf_dynptr_from_skb and registering it

column2: so that unsafe progs like fexit/__kfree_skb are not allowed.

column1: We also need the skb dynptr to be read-only in tp_btf. Because
may_access_direct_pkt_data() returns false by default when checking

column2: there is no need to add BPF_PROG_TYPE_TRACING to it
